prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Upload Verification Flow: Rebuild the photo upload screen into a two-column view with a preview component to verify photo quality before generation. (why: 3 support emails report custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect, contributing to long adoption times.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Sign-in Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in locks your pet to your account across sessions. (why: Support mailbox received 8 complaints about lost pets and account resets after re-logging.)
2: [home, wait_info] Generation Wait Time Indicator: Display explicit progress time estimates and background notification options during the pet generation waiting screen. (why: The waiting stage has a median time of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing drop-offs while waiting for pet creation.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Clarity Copy: Clarify headline and body text on choose_path to clearly differentiate pre-made adoption from custom photo generation. (why: Choose path has a very long mean time of 514s relative to an 8s median, indicating substantial user confusion or hesitation.)
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Notification Setup: Enable desktop notification options on final home intro to alert users when their companion appears on the screen. (why: 3 support messages note pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to launch visibly after setup.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Split Layout Path Chooser: Switch choose_path layout to split layout with active step counter to improve decision structure. (why: The choose_path step exhibits a high mean duration (514s), suggesting screen layout improvements will assist decision speed.)
